track_standard_event.description: Standard track event mapped to an Adjust custom event token via settings. Adjust S2S API requires all events to be pre-mapped to 6-character event tokens in the destination settings; unmapped event names are silently dropped and never forwarded.

expected_api_call.notes: Event name 'Product Viewed' is resolved to event token 'prdvw1' via the customEvents mapping in destination settings. The s2s=1 parameter is always hardcoded. Device identifiers idfa and idfv are extracted from context.device for iOS. All event properties are serialized as a JSON string in callback_params.

track_revenue_event.description: Revenue-bearing track event with properties.revenue and properties.currency translated to Adjust native revenue fields. Adjust uses these fields for revenue attribution and campaign ROAS calculations.

expected_api_call.notes: properties.revenue and properties.currency are extracted and promoted to top-level Adjust revenue and currency parameters for native revenue tracking. Revenue is not duplicated in callback_params. The event token 'ordcmp' maps from 'Order Completed' via customEvents. Nested properties like products array are excluded from callback_params since Adjust only accepts flat string key-value pairs.

track_android_event.description: Track event from an Android device demonstrating the Android-specific device identifier mapping. Android devices use gps_adid (Google Advertising ID) and android_id instead of iOS idfa/idfv.

expected_api_call.notes: Android device: context.device.advertisingId maps to gps_adid (Google Play Services Advertising ID) and context.device.id maps to android_id. The device.type field determines which identifier pair is used. Event token 'prdadd' resolves from 'Product Added' in customEvents settings.

track_event_with_partner_params.description: Track event demonstrating partner parameter forwarding alongside callback parameters. Partner parameters are shared with network partners for attribution and campaign optimization.

expected_api_call.notes: Partner parameters passed via integrations.Adjust.partnerParams are forwarded as a URL-encoded JSON string in partner_params. Revenue is extracted from properties.price when it matches Segment e-commerce spec. Callback params exclude revenue/currency since those are promoted to top-level fields.

track_standard_event.description: RudderStack track event for Adjust with standard event token mapping. The RudderStack payload wraps the event in the standard envelope with additional SDK metadata fields (rudderId, originalTimestamp, sentAt, receivedAt).

expected_api_call.notes: RudderStack envelope adds rudderId, messageId, channel, sentAt, receivedAt, and expanded context (library, network, screen). The transformed API call is identical to the Segment reference — event name resolves to the same event token, device IDs are mapped identically, and callback_params carry the same flat property map.

track_revenue_event.description: RudderStack revenue event for Adjust with properties.revenue and properties.currency promoted to native Adjust revenue fields. RudderStack follows the same Segment e-commerce spec for revenue extraction.

expected_api_call.notes: Revenue extraction is identical between Segment and RudderStack — both follow the e-commerce spec where properties.revenue is promoted to the Adjust revenue parameter. Nested arrays (products) are excluded from callback_params as Adjust requires flat string key-value pairs only. The order_id, total, and tax are included as callback_params for downstream reporting.

track_android_event.description: RudderStack Android track event demonstrating platform-specific device identifier resolution. Android uses gps_adid and android_id mapped from the standard context.device fields.

expected_api_call.notes: Android device identifier mapping is platform-specific: context.device.advertisingId becomes gps_adid (Google Play Services Advertising ID) and context.device.id becomes android_id. This mapping is identical between Segment and RudderStack. The device.type field ('android') drives the identifier pair selection.

track_event_with_partner_params.description: RudderStack track event with partner parameters forwarded via the integrations object. Partner parameters are shared with Adjust network partners for cross-network attribution.

expected_api_call.notes: Partner parameters from integrations.Adjust.partnerParams are forwarded as a URL-encoded JSON string in the partner_params query parameter. This behavior is identical between Segment and RudderStack. Revenue is extracted from properties.price following the e-commerce spec.

event_mapping.description: Event name from the track call is resolved to a 6-character Adjust event token using the customEvents mapping in destination settings. Adjust API only accepts event tokens, not arbitrary event names. Events without a mapping are silently dropped.
Event timestamp converted from ISO 8601 string to Unix epoch seconds for Adjust S2S API time attribution.
Client IP address from event context or request origin, forwarded for geo-attribution and fraud detection.
Always set to '1' to indicate server-to-server event submission. This is a required flag for all Adjust S2S API calls.
Adjust application token from destination configuration settings. Required for every S2S API call to identify the target app.
Set to 'production' for live events or 'sandbox' for testing. Determines which Adjust environment receives the event.

revenue_reporting.description: Revenue amount from the Segment/RudderStack e-commerce spec. Promoted to a top-level Adjust revenue parameter for native revenue attribution and ROAS calculations. Supports decimal precision.
ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required alongside revenue for proper currency conversion in Adjust reporting. Defaults to USD if omitted in Segment.

device_attribution.description: Advertising identifier mapped to the platform-specific Adjust parameter. iOS devices use IDFA (Identifier for Advertisers) and Android devices use GPS Advertising ID. The context.device.type field determines which parameter name is used.

Device vendor/hardware identifier mapped to the platform-specific Adjust parameter. iOS devices map to IDFV (Identifier for Vendor) and Android devices map to android_id. Required for all server-side events.

Device platform type ('ios' or 'android') determines which device identifier parameter names are used in the Adjust API call. Not sent as a separate parameter but drives the idfa/idfv vs gps_adid/android_id decision.

custom_data.description: All track event properties (excluding revenue and currency when present) are serialized as a flat JSON string and passed in the callback_params parameter. Adjust requires flat string key-value pairs only; nested objects and arrays are excluded. Available in Adjust raw data exports.
custom_data.known_gap: Nested object and array properties cannot be forwarded to Adjust callback_params since Adjust only accepts flat string key-value pairs. This is an Adjust API limitation, not a parity issue.

custom_data.description: Optional partner parameters passed via the integrations object are forwarded as a URL-encoded JSON string. Shared with Adjust network partners for cross-network attribution and campaign optimization.

track.notes: Full parity for track events including event token mapping, revenue tracking, device ID resolution (iOS and Android), callback parameters, and partner parameters.

unsupported_event_types.identify: Not supported by Adjust cloud-mode destination. Segment documentation confirms identify is only available in device-mode via addSessionPartnerParameter.

destination_api_differences.description: Adjust API only accepts pre-configured event tokens, not arbitrary event names. Both Segment and RudderStack must map event names to tokens via destination settings. Unmapped events are silently dropped.
destination_api_differences.resolution: Both platforms handle this identically via the customEvents settings mapping.

destination_api_differences.description: Adjust device-mode (SDK-embedded) provides install attribution, session tracking, and deep link handling that are not available in cloud/S2S mode. Cloud mode sends supplemental event data only.
destination_api_differences.resolution: This is an inherent limitation of cloud-mode/S2S integration, not a Segment vs RudderStack parity issue. Both platforms have identical limitations in cloud mode.

destination_api_differences.description: Apple App Tracking Transparency (ATT) consent and SKAdNetwork conversion value handling are device-mode-only features. S2S events for iOS 14+ apps may receive conversion values in the API response that must be forwarded back to the app.
destination_api_differences.resolution: ATT and SKAdNetwork are SDK-level concerns. Cloud-mode events from both platforms behave identically with regard to iOS privacy restrictions.

destination_api_differences.description: Adjust requires callback_params as a URL-encoded JSON string containing only flat string key-value pairs. Nested objects or arrays in event properties must be excluded or flattened.
destination_api_differences.resolution: Both Segment and RudderStack transformers handle the same serialization logic.

required_settings.name: appToken
required_settings.description: Adjust application token found in the Adjust Dashboard under App Settings. Uniquely identifies the app for all S2S API calls. Each app in Adjust has a distinct app token.

required_settings.name: customEvents
required_settings.description: Mapping of Segment/RudderStack track event names to Adjust custom event tokens. Each key is the event name (e.g., 'Product Viewed') and each value is the corresponding 6-character Adjust event token. Only mapped events are forwarded to Adjust; unmapped events are silently dropped.

optional_settings.name: delayTime
optional_settings.description: Delay time in seconds for attribution reporting. Used to defer attribution to allow time for additional data collection. Defaults to 0 (no delay).

optional_settings.name: environment
optional_settings.description: Adjust environment for event submission. Set to 'production' for live data or 'sandbox' for testing in the Adjust Dashboard. Defaults to 'production'.

known_gaps.description: Nested object and array properties in track event properties cannot be forwarded to Adjust callback_params. Adjust S2S API only accepts flat string key-value pairs in the callback_params JSON. This is an Adjust API limitation affecting both Segment and RudderStack equally.
known_gaps.impact: Complex e-commerce properties like products arrays are excluded from Adjust callback data. Only flat scalar properties are forwarded.

known_gaps.description: Install attribution events (install, reattribution, reinstall) are not available in cloud/S2S mode. These are device-mode-only capabilities that require the Adjust SDK to be embedded in the mobile application.
known_gaps.impact: Cloud-mode users cannot receive install attribution data. This is an inherent platform limitation, not a Segment vs RudderStack parity issue.

known_gaps.description: Deep link resolution and deferred deep linking are device-mode-only features. The S2S API does not provide deep link attribution or forwarding capabilities.
known_gaps.impact: Deep linking use cases require the Adjust SDK rather than server-side integration for both Segment and RudderStack.

known_gaps.description: Revenue deduplication via transaction ID is only available through the Adjust SDK. The S2S API does not support automatic deduplication, requiring server-side deduplication before submission.
known_gaps.impact: Duplicate revenue events must be deduplicated by the sending server. Both Segment and RudderStack leave deduplication responsibility to the event producer.

notes: Adjust is a mobile attribution platform. The cloud-mode (S2S) integration sends supplemental track event data only — it does not handle install attribution, session tracking, or deep linking, which are device-mode SDK features. All track events must be pre-mapped to Adjust event tokens in the customEvents destination setting; unmapped events are silently dropped and never forwarded to the Adjust API. Device identifiers are required: context.device.id and context.device.type are mandatory for all server-side events. The platform type (iOS vs Android) determines the specific Adjust device identifier parameter names used (idfa/idfv for iOS, gps_adid/android_id for Android). Revenue tracking is fully supported — properties.revenue and properties.currency are automatically promoted to native Adjust revenue parameters. All other flat event properties are forwarded as callback_params for inclusion in Adjust raw data exports. Partner parameters can be passed via the integrations object for cross-network attribution sharing. The Adjust S2S API endpoint is https://s2s.adjust.com/event with s2s=1 always set. Payload parity between Segment and RudderStack is high for the supported track event type in cloud mode.
